inv.noParent: No parent or guardian on file
inv.dismissedNote: {{who}} dismissed this flag on {{when}}: "{{reason}}". It stays dismissed unless the records get worse.
inv.notPrediction: This is a prompt to check in with the family, based only on the records shown. It isn't a prediction that the student will leave.
inv.howScored: How the score of {{score}} was worked out
inv.noPoints: No warning signs, so no points.
inv.scoreRules: High from {{high}} points, medium from {{medium}}. Compares the last {{window}} days with the {{baseline}} days before. One point for each percentage point attendance falls (up to 35), {{cancel}} for each family cancellation (up to 24), {{noShow}} for each missed lesson (up to 16), 3 for each moved lesson (up to 9), {{concern}} for each open concern (up to 20), 10 when lessons become much less frequent and 6 when nothing is booked. Tutor cancellations and confidential notes never add points.
inv.recordsNote: If a record is wrong, correct it at the source and run the analysis again, or dismiss the flag with a reason.
inv.dismissWhy: Why is this flag wrong? This is saved with your name.
inv.dismissPlaceholder: For example: the family told us about a planned holiday.

reset.title: Reset the Demo
reset.text: Puts the fictional students, lessons, concerns and check-ins back as they started. Real records are never touched.
reset.done: The demo has been reset. Only fictional records were restored.
reset.confirmText: Drafts, approvals, simulated sends, dismissed flags and replies in the demo will be cleared and the fictional records restored. Records that aren't demo data stay as they are.
